EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Supervisor Membership
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance support. We'll be happy to speak to why (NAME) is unable to (TASK). After reviewing this employee's account, we've found that (NAME) is still assigned to the (GROUP NAME) security group.
If you navigate to Security Setup > User Security for this employee, you will see that the Group Membership section still lists an employee-level assignment. For a supervisor to access data for their staff and perform supervisory functions within Time & Attendance, they will need a supervisor-level Group Membership assignment (or higher). To correct this, simply remove the employee-level assignment, add the supervisor-level assignment, and click the SAVE button. Once these changes have been saved, this supervisor will see the updated supervisory access upon their next login.
Please note that each user should have exactly one Group Membership assignment at any time, as a duplicate or missing assignment can create a security conflict, resulting in login errors and/or loss of function upon login.
You can access these instructions by visiting our Help Center here. If you have any additional questions or concerns, please let us know and we'll be happy to help.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
